ValidationRule.description: Restricts Users from reopening a Lost Opp if they are no the Owner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Closed Lost"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Not Upsold")), $User.Id <> OwnerId, $Profile.Name != "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to re-open an Opportunity owned by another User.
